<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a third consecutive session, pressured by sustained FII outflows and volatility in crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxORHBMamd5dGRTRjdQMzBmSTZndTlkdGxISTJxTy16X0syMTlhQkY2ckx6elJvRUFSdWFjakxmNlNMeUNPR0tMbktGT0pjS2ZJWTZXQ3h1YWI1akpibFFOVGFCWDRJSmZVSmVQRW01ZTNQT2JCdnEtVk9kZDhaMVNQdDUybm1QNm9QQXRHbGJheEd6M0R1eENjR3Z5MmRzZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Outlook:</strong> BofA Securities projects the RBI may implement a 100 bps repo rate hike through the first half of 2027, potentially impacting future loan EMIs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Stance:</strong> The government has clarified that SEBI currently has no plans to permit stock exchanges like the NSE and BSE to trade their own shares.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Performance Trends:</strong> Indian equity markets are on track for their weakest nine-month performance in 15 years, with the Nifty 50 recording its worst September in eight years.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Capital Flows:</strong> FIIs have offloaded approximately ₹9,980 crore in Indian equities, contributing significantly to the ongoing downward pressure on benchmark indices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPZVBnNGxEb21GRW5XUkl5X3BkZ29lN1dQak1scVVIMnZRZWQ3QzhrMkhFZkJSNk5SdUtRam5jN2l0QWVreVdOekp1T1ZzWS1kd2h4RGZfaUJxWGRhMGpYZGY4eGtUU2tlZGFfa2JuU2V6bEJNdGhJb2M4Nkl4QTRwcmR3eG9kT2pwVGhoOE9RMXJYczYyelNpUGR0aVZOV3BySWRVVlY1cU1OeHFiZmlweXBGZVJWUnNoelZHVDVDQjc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
</ul>
